This is the original printed text (version 1 of 2). The current text is [[Yané (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Each version below is quoted with its dated source, in date order; bracketed names such as [Pilot] stand for icons printed on the cards, ▲ is the icon for “take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle” and ▼ the icon for “deploy from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”.
* '''Original''' (this page): Players Committee Virtual Set 1 card sheet<ref name="eh1362-ya-0">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-1.pdf Virtual Set 1 card sheet], Players Committee, page 3. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20150513073607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-1.pdf Internet Archive], captured 13 May 2015.</ref>. Dated by 13 May 2015 (the earliest preserved copy of the Players Committee Set 1 card sheet); the day of first publication is not known.{{Mystery|question=On what day was this version of Yané (V) first published}} The PC card image with the same words is in the Holotable repository by 8 July 2018 (commit 022435b). Text: “Whenever opponent deploys a character to same or adjacent site, may activate 1 Force. While with Amidala, forfeit +1, and once per turn may peek at the top card of your Force Pile and Reserve Deck; return one card to each deck or pile.” No errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Yané (V) (Errata)]]): Players Committee card image<ref name="eh1362-ya-1">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Light/large/yane.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ca1ccff62ff30b7e29da803f91a6d09ab542d803 commit ca1ccff] (3 October 2022).</ref>. First published 3 October 2022. The PC re-made the image at higher resolution (350×490 → 745×1039 pixels). Text: “Whenever opponent deploys a character to same or adjacent site, may activate 1 Force. While with Amidala, forfeit +1 and; once per turn, may peek at the top card of your Force Pile and Reserve Deck; return one card to each deck or pile.” '''What changed:''' game text: “forfeit +1, and once per turn may peek” → “forfeit +1 and; once per turn, may peek” (the comma after “+1” moved behind “turn” and a semicolon follows “and”); the margin title lost its uniqueness dot. No errata mark. Before/after (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V1-L-yane-2022-10-03-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] → [[File:V1-L-yane-2022-10-03-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]]. This is change 1 in release order, so the missing mark is listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026: number versions by release order and record the printed mark). This is the current text.
